testcase.system-out: Scenario: Float and redock the drawing browser ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-drawing.odd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And its browser is docked to the left of the drawing ✔ When the user drags the browser header into the drawing area ✔ Then the browser floats over the drawing sheet ✔ And the browser displays drawing resources and the sheet tree ✔ And the drawing remains visible behind the browser ✔ When the user drags the floating browser header to the left edge of the workspace ✔ Then the browser docks at the left edge ✔ And the drawing remains visible in the remaining workspace
